capabilities: Queue whole notes for spaced-repetition or fixed-interval review via a note property
Rate spaced reviews as Again, Hard, Good or Easy to adjust intervals and ease
Open a review queue and review the next due note by command or ribbon icon
Show due-note counts in the status bar and remind you when notes are due
Configure default modes, intervals, ignored paths and queue behavior in settings
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; requires manual installation of release files into the plugins folder. Spaced-scheduling constants (start ease, easy bonus, lapse factor) are not in the settings tab and must be edited in data.json.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a rewrite based on obsidian-spaced-repetition by Stephen Mwangi and contributors.
problem: Notes are typically written once and never reread, and Obsidian's spaced-repetition approach centers on flashcards rather than resurfacing the full note as written.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a rewrite based on obsidian-spaced-repetition by Stephen Mwangi and contributors.

summary: Schedules whole notes for review with spaced repetition or fixed intervals, tracked in note properties instead of flashcards.
